what_changed: FMVSS 108 amended to permit adaptive driving beam (S9.4.1.6 Option 2): system must detect malfunctions (incl. sensor obstruction), fall back to manual mode with a visible driver warning, give lower beam only below 32 km/h, and switch only between lower/upper/ADB in automatic mode
note: Optional (permissive) function, but where fitted it requires forward sensing, malfunction detection and segmented-beam control; FR 2024-12-30 (89 FR 106365) denied petitions, no amendment

what_changed: Reversing lamps with more than one light source: on failure of one light source either minimum intensity is kept or a signal for activation of a failure tell-tale (R48 para. 6.4.8) must be produced (new para. 6.1.6)
note: Optional alternative (failure signal) adopted in the GRE multi-light-source package; existing lamps can keep option (a)
